artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: Added class BlpResponseError(RuntimeError) (new, named per RULED text). historical_data() gained on_response_error: str = "ignore" (default). handle() now: if the message carries no securityData AND on_response_error=="raise" AND the message carries responseError, raises BlpResponseError(f"{category}: {message}"); otherwise (on_response_error=="ignore", the default, or no responseError present) returns silently -- byte-for-byte the prior early-return behaviour, so every existing caller (reference_data untouched, historical_data's own no-kwarg call sites) is unchanged. No other function touched. py_compile clean, ruff (py39) clean, 0 CRLF, 0 non-ASCII bytes.

Added HIST_FIELDS_PER_REQUEST = 25 beside HIST_START/PERIODICITY. Added _hist_field_chunks(fields, per_request) (list-slice split, order preserved) and _merge_historical_by_date(chunk_results) (merges N historical_data() chunk results into ONE {security: [{date, field: value,...}]} result, one row per date, later chunks never overwriting a field an earlier chunk already supplied). stage_pull's single 39-field blp.historical_data(...) call replaced by a loop over _hist_field_chunks(HIST_FIELDS, HIST_FIELDS_PER_REQUEST) (2 chunks: 25, 14), each call carrying on_response_error="raise"; pull_log gains one HistoricalDataRequest entry per chunk (fields=<that chunk's field list>, chunk=<i>, chunks_total=<n>); hist is _merge_historical_by_date(hist_chunk_results). cmd_pull's --dry-run branch: the old single combined ReferenceDataRequest+HistoricalDataRequest print line is split -- the ReferenceDataRequest line is unchanged in content (HEADER_FIELDS only); one new line per historical chunk reads 'DRY-RUN PULL: <security> -> would send HistoricalDataRequest chunk <i> of <n> fields=<k> (security=..., request_fields=<chunk fields>, start_date=..., end_date=..., periodicity=...)' -- the request_fields clause keeps the 22 CRPS-e-2 mnemonics visible in dry-run stdout (see surprise row AMGT_CORPUS-Z-W2-S7: the RULED count-only literal alone broke a sibling READ-ONLY test). No change to HIST_FIELDS' 39 members, FORECAST_FIELDS, FIELD_BASIS, HEADER_FIELDS, HIST_START, PERIODICITY, any bronze/state landing address, the --securities cap (3), or the derive stage. py_compile clean, ruff (py39) clean, 0 CRLF, 0 non-ASCII bytes.

New file, 12 tests, fully OFFLINE (no network, no real blpapi call): (1) module-import regression -- model_block_pull imports without pulling blpapi into sys.modules; (2) HIST_FIELDS_PER_REQUEST==25; (3) 39 HIST_FIELDS chunk into [25,14], order preserved, concatenation reconstructs the original list exactly; (4) a generic 52-field/25-per-request case chunks [25,25,2]; (5) stage_pull's source text is statically checked to pass on_response_error="raise" and to call _hist_field_chunks/_merge_historical_by_date; (6-8) _merge_historical_by_date joins fields from different chunks onto one row per date, a date seen in only one chunk still appears once, multiple securities merge independently; (9-12) blp_client.historical_data exercised against a MINIMAL FAKE blpapi module injected under sys.modules['blpapi'] for a PRIVATE module load (never touching the real blpapi package installed on this box or any blp_client module object a sibling test file already holds cached) -- a responseError message returns {} under the default ("ignore", and explicitly "ignore"), raises blp.BlpResponseError('LIMIT: too many fields requested') under "raise", and a clean securityData response still returns its row normally under "raise". py_compile clean, ruff (py39) clean, 0 CRLF, 0 non-ASCII bytes.
